info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Drops-v3-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve a list of education enrollment drops, providing vital insights into student engagement and retention. By accessing this resource, educational institutions can analyze trends and patterns related to enrollment drops, facilitating more effective decision-making and intervention strategies. The API serves stakeholders such as administrators, educators, and data analysts who seek to understand and address the challenges of student retention. Utilize this endpoint to enhance program development and improve overall educational outcomes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details regarding enrollment drops, including the reasons and student statuses associated with the drop process. It provides insights into the enrollment lifecycle management.
